name: limitwise
description: Quota-aware Codex task scheduling with terse default replies. Tested only on Linux x86-64; macOS and Apple Silicon are untested.

interface.shortDescription: Schedule Codex tasks within usage limits.
interface.longDescription: Plan Codex tasks with terse default replies, predict likely and conservative usage from local run history, warn about tight caps, execute at exact local times or after preceding tasks under a percentage or token budget, and inspect stored token history while preserving weekly and rolling five-hour quota reserves. LimitWise has only been tested on Linux x86-64; macOS, including Apple Silicon, and other architectures are untested.
defaultPrompt: Plan and schedule these Codex tasks.
Check my Codex usage before scheduling.
